guarantees.claim: On posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni, if rst_ni is low, state_q is cleared to all zeros; otherwise, if state_we equals SP2V_HIGH, state_q is updated with state_d, else it holds its current value.
guarantees.cond: always (on posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni)

assumptions.claim: External logic must provide a correct cryptographic state_d and assert state_we to SP2V_HIGH only when state_d is valid and intended to be stored.
assumptions.cond: during normal operation when state_q is being updated
assumptions.risk: If state_we is falsely asserted or state_d is corrupted, invalid secret state is stored, which may break AES computation or leak intermediate values.

uncertain_points.claim: The generation and timing of state_we and state_d are outside this chunk; a glitch or unexpected assertion of state_we could cause state_q to latch invalid data at the wrong time.
uncertain_points.cond: when state_we combinational logic or other source is unconstrained
uncertain_points.risk: Corrupted AES state may produce wrong ciphertext or leak internal state through subsequent operations.
